card.name: End of page footer text
card.fires_on: Final punctuation such as a period, bracket or pipe at the end of a web page's main content, just before footer, navigation or copyright material.

modes.label: Copyright and credits line end
modes.description: The period or closing mark ending a copyright, rights or citation line near the bottom of a page.
modes.example: © 1996-2008 National Geographic Society. All rights reserved<<.|>>

modes.label: Pipe or bracket before menus
modes.description: A pipe or closing parenthesis that ends an item and leads into site menus or staff-only links.

card.writes: It seems to push toward closing-style tokens such as comment endings and markup ends, and away from end-of-text.
card.plain: It marks the point where an article's content stops and the page's footer or menu clutter begins.
